bin-width.alt: Minutes 30 students spent on homework, from 12 to 75, shown three ways on the same scale from 10 to 80 minutes. Top: a dotplot with one dot per student. Middle: a histogram with bins 5 minutes wide, which shows more detail. Bottom: a histogram with bins 10 minutes wide, which is smoother; the tallest bin, 30 to 40 minutes, holds 9 students.
